base_member_text: cross-line defect candidate: Hmo_Syy1d_th (L28) sums Syy1d_th, which is initialized to zeros(1,mtheta) at L6 and never written afterwards — the computed Hmo is always 0; the integrated spectrum actually lives in Syy1d_th_unique (L19-27), and the only use of Hmo_Syy1d_th is the commented-out title (L43)
audit_member_text: Definite variable-selection defect across L6, L19-L28: directional energy is accumulated into Syy1d_th_unique, but Hmo_Syy1d_th is calculated from the separate Syy1d_th array that remains all zeros. The diagnostic is therefore always zero regardless of input energy.
The zero Hmo diagnostic is not exposed because the title at L43 is commented, so the variable mismatch is silently hidden from output.

base_member_text: reps computed in L9-16 is never used elsewhere in this file
audit_member_text: The O(mfreq^2) reps calculation at L9-L16 uses exact float equality and its result is never consumed; repetitions do not affect the directional integration or plot.

base_member_text: unit mix across arguments: theta/theta_unique are plotted in radians (L33, L40) while theta_mean is converted by *pi/180 (L33, L35, L36), implying degrees — conventions are defined by the caller, not this file
directional integration (L23-24) multiplies by scalar freq_resolution, assuming uniform frequency spacing; validity depends on the generator that built freq

audit_member_text: Direction grouping at L22 uses exact equality, so nearly identical theta values remain separate even if they represent the same direction numerically.

mfreq is trusted at L9/L11/L21 rather than checked against freq, theta, and Spectrum_Energy lengths; inconsistent inputs cause out-of-range access, and freq_resolution shape is not validated for the multiplication continued at L23-L24.
